mapper.select: select c.id, c.`specific`, c.discount_type, c.discount_value, c.threshold_amount, c.max_discount_amount, uc.id as creater from user_coupon uc inner join coupon c on uc.coupon_id = c.id where uc.user_id = #{userId} and uc.status = 1 and uc.term_begin_time <= now() and uc.term_end_time > now()
